parsed.rationale: The ticket says the app is 'broken again' and nothing works anymore, but provides no specific symptoms, error messages, impacted workflow, or evidence of outage/security/billing/data loss. Mentions boss is mad and asks to fix, implying important workflow impact; however, routing details are insufficient.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi—sorry you’re running into this again. I understand this is impacting you and you need it resolved quickly.

To get this fixed as fast as possible, can you reply with the following minimum details?
1) What feature/workflow “doesn’t work anymore” (exact steps from what you click to what happens)
2) Any error message text you see (or a screenshot)
3) When it started (date/time) and whether it affects all users or just your account/environment
4) Whether you can still reproduce it right now

If you have any prior incident reference or ticket ID from “last time,” please include that as well.

Once I have those details, we’ll escalate to the engineering team to investigate immediately.
promised_actions: Escalate to the engineering team to investigate
Request specific reproduction and error details to proceed
safety_notes: No refund, root-cause, or resolution promise included.
The ticket lacks specifics (feature, errors, timestamps, affected scope), so the response asks for minimum useful clarification.

parsed.customer_impact: The customer indicates their app is non-functional for them (“Nothing works anymore”) and that the repeated issue is causing organizational pressure (“my boss is mad”), implying significant disruption to their operations.
grounded_facts: The ticket subject says: "This is broken again".
The customer states the app keeps doing "the same thing as last time."
The customer says they do not have time to explain this again.
The customer says: "my boss is mad."
missing_information: What specifically is not working (which feature/workflow and what the user expected vs what happened).
Any error messages, logs, screenshots, or exact observed behavior.
What changed since the last time (if any) and when the issue started / how long it has been happening.
Whether this is affecting all users or only specific accounts/environments (e.g., region, device, plan).
Whether there is an outage/incident already in progress and any relevant timestamps/incident IDs.
Any evidence of data loss, security issues, or billing problems (not mentioned).
risk_signals: Production-like impact implied by "Nothing works anymore" and "fix it" request
Recurring failure implied by "the same thing as last time"
High urgency implied by "my boss is mad" and "I do not have time to explain this again"
No details provided, increasing troubleshooting and misrouting risk
parsed.summary: The customer reports that the app is broken again, with nothing working anymore, and requests an immediate fix because the issue is repeating from a prior incident.
